{{Top}}
{{Quote|Arriving at the prison now.|[[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]]|<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>}}
[[File:Republic_Judiciary_Central_Detention_Center.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on Coruscant]]

'''Prisons''' were installations primarily used for incarcerating [[Prisoner/Legends|individuals]].

==Types of prisons==
[[File:Gamorrean-SWGs6.jpg|left|thumb||180px|A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] in a Hutt dungeon]]
Different prisons used various methods to contain individuals, either through locking them in a physical cage, or with the use of simple force field barriers or [[Containment field/Legends|containment fields]], such as those used by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]. [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] palaces sometimes contained dungeons with barred cells. Some containment devices, such as [[Force cage]]s, could also be modified to project electrical currents through the captured individuals as a form of [[Torture/Legends|torture]].

The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] were known to utilize an incarceration method called the [[mind prison]], where the prisoner's mind would be stripped from their body and be locked away within the prison device, presumably forever. According to one [[Unidentified Rakatan prisoner|Rakatan prisoner]], the only means of escape was by transferring the imprisoned mind into the body of another who had inadvertently become trapped, although this required the consent of both involved.<ref>''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

Entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]] were occasionally used as prisons. Planets such as [[Mytus VII/Legends|Mytus VII]], also known as [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]], was known as one of the most dreaded prison planets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Despayre]] was another prison planet used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but was [[Destruction of Despayre|destroyed]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] as part of a test of its firepower.<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

The Jedi Order also kept a secret prison to hold dangerous sometimes [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] beings.

==Notable prisons==
[[Belsavis prison]] was one of the oldest prisons in existence, a super-prison constructed by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. It contained extremely ferocious prisoners, and was adapted for use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Unfortunately for the Republic, in the early years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] discovered its location and sent [[Imperial Agent|agents]] into the prison to liberate important Imperial prisoners, causing the planet to become a battleground.

[[File:PrisonBreak-TUR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] prisoner attempt to break out of prison]]
[[Desolation Alley]] was a notable prison on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]],<ref name="Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> which held a number of prisoners such as [[Meeko Ghintee]] and [[Bendix Fust]]. It was also used for [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]], which was virtually the only form of entertainment available to the prisoners. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] both attempted to recover Fust from the heavily guarded prison. It was during this successful escape attempt that Jango Fett procured the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|Firespray-class patrol ship]] that he later named the [[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]], after the loss of his [[Jaster's Legacy|original ship]] in the skirmish.

During the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] housed criminals in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], not far from the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]].

Possibly the most notable, however, is the prison camp on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] which was home to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] largest [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|mining operation]]. Under Imperial rule, [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor was extensively used in the mines. Kessel would hold many [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] prisoners of war during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] such as [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who would be [[Rescue on Kessel|rescued]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="RS I">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> The crime lord [[Tyber Zann]] was also incarcerated at Kessel for [[Battle of Felucia (Zann Consortium)|stealing]] a [[Carbonite Sith Army holocron|Sith holocron]] from the Empire and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. He would later escape thanks to [[Urai Fen]] creating a [[Ground Battle on Kessel|prison riot]] diversion.<ref name="Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

[[Ysanne Isard]] maintained a private prison in the belly of the her star cruiser [[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]], from which [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] escaped in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="X-Wing">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
